lineage: S104 showed that sweep-anchored stops cut stress loss by 81%, but remained negative. Its frozen excursion audit found +$1.21/PF 1.33 for exact sweep stops >=2 ATR, -$4.17 for shallower stops, four losses from four zones older than 24h, and worsening performance from static three-of-three confluence. S105 predeclares independent geometry, reset-flow, target-space and combined variants.

common_rules.execution: Closed 15m state machine; next 5m open; one global position.
common_rules.direction: S101 global UP/DOWN plus aligned closed 4h EMA50.
common_rules.sweep: Penetrate the previous 20 closed 15m high/low by 0.02 ATR and close back through it.
common_rules.stop: Exact sweep extreme plus 0.15 ATR; never artificially widen.
common_rules.risk: 0.2% equity capped at $0.50; 75% notional; leverage <=5; no risk increase in S105.
common_rules.history: 2025-05-01 inclusive to 2026-09-01 exclusive; same verified Binance cache as S103/S104.

geometry.change: Require zone age <=24h and exact structural stop distance between 2.0 and 4.0 ATR15.
geometry.confluence: Unchanged S104 static two-of-three micro score.

geometry_reset.change: At the sweep require 15m OI change <=0 and taker aggression against the intended direction; at confirmation require directional taker reversal and improving 15m OI. Static confluence minimum becomes one because the causal sequence replaces the static OI point.

geometry_target.change: Target 90% of the distance to the opposite prior-20-bar liquidity extreme. Require at least 2.5R both at decision close and actual next-open fill.

full.change: Combine reset-flow sequence and opposing-liquidity target; static confluence minimum one.
full.selection: No variant may be altered after seeing S105 output.

historical_gate.per_variant: Stress >=12 fills, PnL >0, PF >1.05, DD <=10%; validation >=4 fills and PnL >0; severe PnL >0.
historical_gate.breadth: At least two symbols represented and neither long nor short sleeve negative under stress.
historical_gate.robustness: At least two leave-one-out runs positive and bootstrap p10 positive.
historical_gate.promotion: A pass can authorize prospective paper-forward only.

disclosures: All S105 history is selection-contaminated by S103/S104 diagnostics.
The 2 ATR and 24h hypotheses are explicitly post-hoc and require prospective confirmation.
Risk overlays can reduce drawdown but cannot manufacture positive expectancy.
